Title: Is your diabetes medication behind that tingling in your hands and feet? 3 real causes of numbness

Description:
If your hands or feet keep tingling and you can't figure out why, it's probably not just "getting older" - it could be one of these three things.

Metformin, soda, and hours of sitting are three things doctors connect to nerve tingling and numbness, and each one has an easy fix that doesn't mean giving anything up completely.

Watch to find out why these cause tingling, and what actually helps.
